```python
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    n = next(i + 1 for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i >= 1
             and row[0] != 7 and all(x == row[0] for x in row[:i + 1]))
    a = [row[:n] for row in grid[:n]]
    sep = a[-1][0]
    obj = next(x for row in a for x in row if x not in (7, sep))
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(n - 1) for c in range(n - 1) if a[r][c] == obj]
    width = n
    square = n == 3 and len(cells) == 4 and a[0][1] == obj and a[1][1] == obj and a[1][0] == 7
    compressed = n == 3 and len(cells) == 4 and not square
    if compressed:
        width = 2
    out = []
    for r in range(h):
        row = []
        for c in range(w):
            v = a[r % n][c % width]
            flip = ((r // n) + (c // width)) % 2 == 1
            if square:
                flip = (c // width) % 2 == 1
                flip = not flip
            if v == 7:
                row.append(7)
            elif flip:
                row.append(sep if v == obj else obj)
            else:
                row.append(v)
        out.append(row)
    return out
```

```python
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    n = next(i + 1 for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i >= 1
             and row[0] != 7 and all(x == row[0] for x in row[:i + 1]))
    sep = grid[n - 1][0]
    obj = next(x for row in grid[:n - 1] for x in row[:n - 1] if x != 7)
    k = n - 1
    mask = [[grid[r][c] != 7 for c in range(k)] for r in range(k)]
    if all(all(row) for row in mask):
        return [[7 if c % n == 0 else (sep if c < n else obj)
                 for c in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    return [[7 if not mask[r % k][c % k] else
             (obj if mask[(r // k) % k][(c // k) % k] else sep)
             for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
```
